title: ReproBreak: A Dataset of Reproducible Web Locator Breaks
abstract: arXiv:2605.12158v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automated GUI testing frameworks such as Cypress and Playwright rely on locators to find and interact with web elements. A locator break occurs when a structural change in the application under test causes a locator to no longer find its target element, resulting in test breakages even when the underlying functionality remains unchanged. Despite its impact on test maintenance, no dataset exists to evaluate locator fragility in Cypress and Playwright at scale. In this paper, we present ReproBreak, a dataset of reproducible locator breaks in web application GUI tests. We analyzed 359 open-source repositories to identify commits that contain locator changes. To confirm whether these changes are indeed locator breaks, we reproduced them in the top 4 projects with the largest number of locator changes and found 449 locator breaks, which are provided in the dataset along with scripts for automated reproduction. translated_title: ReproBreak：一个可复现的Web定位器失效数据集
translated_abstract: 诸如Cypress和Playwright等自动化GUI测试框架依赖定位器来查找网页元素并与之交互。当被测应用程序的结构发生变化导致定位器无法再找到其目标元素时，就会发生定位器失效，即使底层功能保持不变，也会导致测试中断。尽管定位器失效对测试维护有重大影响，但目前尚无数据集可用于大规模评估Cypress和Playwright中定位器的脆弱性。在本文中，我们提出了ReproBreak，这是一个包含Web应用程序GUI测试中可复现定位器失效的数据集。我们分析了359个开源仓库，以识别包含定位器变更的提交。为了确认这些变更是否确实是定位器失效，我们在定位器变更数量最多的前4个项目中复现了这些变更，共发现了449个定位器失效，这些失效连同自动化复现脚本一起被包含在数据集中。我们相信ReproBreak可以用于……
tldr: 本文提出了ReproBreak数据集，通过分析359个开源仓库并在定位器变更最多的4个项目中复现验证，构建了包含449个可复现的Web GUI测试定位器失效案例及其自动化复现脚本的数据集，填补了大规模评估定位器脆弱性的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ReproBreak, a dataset of 449 reproducible web locator breaks identified by analyzing 359 open-source repositories and reproducing changes in the top 4 projects with the most locator changes, filling the gap in large-scale evaluation of locator fragility in Cypress and Playwright.
